name: Kyoko
source:
Silvia and Mayuko's Aunt. A flirty and laid back woman who likes to have fun. She longs to see Mayuko recover and give her some freedom, but her conflicting views with her sister make that difficult. Isn't the most reliable person in the world. 

[Edited from [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1766810169/reska-a-yuri-visual-novel/posts/2062000]Kickstarter Campaign Update[/url]]
